summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 7: Product Variants. All 14 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend features tested and working: Product detail page with variant selector, default/selected/sold-out states, price updates, stock indicators, cart integration with variant labels, admin variant management with CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: All frontend API calls correctly use relative URLs (/api/...) to avoid CORS issues
Product detail page correctly fetches item with variants via GET /api/menu/items/:id
Variant selector shows REQUIRED badge and 'Select Variant' header
First in-stock variant is pre-selected by default with checkmark and maroon border
Sold out variants show greyed out state, strikethrough, 'SOLD OUT' text, and are disabled
Price updates correctly when selecting different variants
Stock indicator shows 'X left' for variants with limited stock
CartContext correctly includes variant in cart line with fullKey combining varKey + modKey
Cart drawer shows variant name below item name in primary color
Different variants of same item create separate cart lines
Cart correctly uses variant price, not base price
Products without variants work normally without variant selector
Admin Variants page at /admin/variants shows all 10 items with variant counts
Admin can expand item to see variants table with name, price, stock, status columns
Admin can add new variant via inline form
Admin can delete variant from table
Admin sidebar includes 'Variants' link between Categories and Modifiers
seed_data_creation: 4 items with variants seeded: item-001 (3 variants: 250g/500g/1kg), item-005 (4 variants: Single/6-Pack/12-Pack/Case), item-006 (2 variants: Regular/Large), item-010 (3 variants: Small/Medium/Large). 6 items without variants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 variants fully tested. All features working: (1) Product detail page at /product/:id shows variant selector for items with variants, (2) Variant buttons show name, price, stock indicator, (3) First in-stock variant pre-selected with checkmark, (4) Sold out variants disabled with strikethrough and 'SOLD OUT' text, (5) Price updates when selecting variants, (6) Cart includes variant in line item with fullKey, (7) Cart drawer shows variant name below item name in primary color, (8) Different variants create separate cart lines, (9) Admin at /admin/variants shows all items with variant counts, (10) Admin can expand item to see/add/edit/delete variants, (11) Sidebar has Variants link between Categories and Modifiers. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED (visual placeholders only).
